{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the sentinel value in customer_age
print(f"Number of rows with customer_age == -1: {df[df['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]}")

# Check for invalid revenue values (e.g., 999999.99) - QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue == '999999.99'): {qa_orders.shape[0]}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}")

# Check that 'converted' is binary
print(f"Unique values in 'converted': {df['converted'].unique()}")

# Check the data type of revenue
print(f"Data type of 'revenue': {df['revenue'].dtype}")

# Show first few rows to inspect
print(df.head())"}
